# ReadDir <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
ReadDir:Int32 dirname:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dirname` | In | String | required | The folder to list. |

**Returns:** A folder handle, or 0 when the folder does not exist.

## Description

Opens a folder so its entries can be listed with [NextFile](NextFile).
